data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Chart.js Integration
features.description: Integrate Chart.js to visualize pipeline metrics, cost tracking, and success rates.
acceptance_criteria: Charts are implemented using Chart.js.
Pipeline metrics are visualized with an 8-stage pipeline chart.
Cost tracking and success rates are displayed using appropriate chart types.

features.title: Live Metrics Dashboard
features.description: Develop a real-time dashboard with Chart.js graphs for live metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard includes a line chart for LLM cost over time.
Stage completion rates are shown with a bar chart.
Success rate trends are visualized with an area chart.

features.title: Auto-Advance and Navigation Controls
features.description: Implement auto-advance for slides with navigation controls for user interaction.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance after a set interval.
Users can manually navigate slides using controls.
Navigation controls are intuitive and responsive.

features.title: Results Display
features.description: Showcase real metrics from recent runs with actual data.
acceptance_criteria: Metrics are sourced from recent Artemis runs.
Data is displayed accurately and clearly.
Charts reflect real-world performance.

features.title: Integration Visualization
features.description: Show supervisor integration across stages using a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: Pie chart accurately represents integration data.
Chart is clear and easy to interpret.
Integration data is sourced from recent metrics.

features.title: HTML Presentation Setup
features.description: Create a standalone HTML file with embedded CSS, JavaScript, and Chart.js for the Artemis demo.
acceptance_criteria: HTML file includes all necessary CSS and JavaScript inline.
Chart.js library is embedded and functional.
File is named artemis_demo_chartjs.html and saved to /tmp.

features.title: Code Quality Metrics
features.description: Display TDD compliance and SOLID principles using a radar chart.
acceptance_criteria: Radar chart includes metrics for TDD compliance.
SOLID principles are represented in the chart.
Chart is visually clear and informative.

features.title: Professional Visual Design
features.description: Apply a professional gradient background and smooth transitions to the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Presentation includes a gradient background.
Transitions between slides are smooth and visually appealing.
Design aligns with professional standards.

features.title: HERO Slide: Introduction to Artemis
features.description: Create a HERO slide explaining Artemis as an Autonomous AI Development System.
acceptance_criteria: Slide includes a clear and concise description of Artemis.
Visuals support the narrative of Artemis as an AI system.
Slide is engaging and informative.
